members.member: Radius of the bottom hemisphere. If different from [member top_radius], the capsule becomes tapered. If greater than [member top_radius] + [member mid_height], the capsule becomes a sphere.

Total height of the capsule mesh (including the hemispherical ends). [b]Note:[/b] The [member height] of a capsule must be at least twice its [member radius], or [member top_radius] + [member bottom_radius] for a tapered capsule. Otherwise, the capsule becomes a sphere. If the [member height] is less than twice the [member radius], the properties adjust to a valid value.
Height of the midsection of the capsule
Number of radial segments on the capsule mesh.
Radius of the capsule mesh. [b]Note:[/b] If the [member radius] of a capsule is greater than half of its [member height], the capsule becomes a sphere.
Number of rings along the height of the capsule.
Check if the capsule is tapered or not
Radius of the top hemisphere. If different from [member bottom_radius], the capsule becomes tapered. If greater than [member bottom_radius] + [member mid_height], the capsule becomes a sphere.
